title: Checkout service high latency from Redis timeout
summary: Checkout service p99 latency spiked to 4.8s. Redis connection pool exhausted. Error rate 18%. Users experiencing slow checkout.
root_cause: Redis connection pool exhausted. Pool size 64 but concurrent connections peaked at 200+.
fix: Increase Redis connection pool size from 64 to 128. Set idle connection timeout to 30s.

title: Order service OOM killed pods
summary: Order processing pods repeatedly OOM killed by Kubernetes. Queue depth growing to millions. Memory leak in image processor.
root_cause: Memory leak in image processing worker. Large images not garbage collected. Heap grew to 4GB before OOM.
fix: Fix memory leak by explicitly releasing image buffers. Set memory limit to 2GB. Add HPA.

title: Kafka consumer lag spike
summary: Kafka consumer group lag increased to 500K messages. Event-driven services stopped processing. Broker disk at 95%.
root_cause: Kafka brokers disk space exhaustion due to excessive log retention. Brokers unable to accept new writes.
fix: Reduce log retention from 7 days to 24 hours. Add disk space monitoring alerts at 80%.

title: PostgreSQL connection timeout across services
summary: All services experiencing PostgreSQL connection timeouts. Database connection pool maxed at 100 connections. Long-running analytical queries holding connections.
root_cause: Database connection pool maxed out. Long-running analytical queries holding connections for minutes.
fix: Move analytical queries to read replicas. Increase connection pool to 200. Add 30s query timeout.

title: Payment service CPU spike from infinite retry loop
summary: Payment service CPU at 100%. Request timeouts across all endpoints. Service stuck in infinite retry loop calling downstream payment gateway.
root_cause: Infinite retry loop in payment gateway client. No exponential backoff. Each failed request spawned 3 retries.
fix: Add exponential backoff with max 3 retries. Add circuit breaker. Set retry delay to 1s, 2s, 4s.
